1. **The doctor’s name** (e.g., Dr. Srinivasa) or  
2. **The appointment ID** (if you have it on hand)

With that, I’ll retrieve the exact date & time for your visit. If you prefer, I can also check the clinic calendar for that doctor and suggest an alternate slot if needed. Let me know what works best for you!
